description: Search recent posts on X by keyword, hashtag or from:account: 20 posts with text, likes, reposts, replies, views, date and link. No X account or key needed. Use it when: You need real-time reaction, news or discussion on a topic. Not for: Follower lists, private accounts or direct messages. Returns: 20 posts: text, author handle and follower count, likes, reposts, replies, quotes, views, date, media and link. Typical time: about 4 s. Price: $0.006 per search (up to 20 posts), charged only on success. One call = up to 20 posts.
